name: Presentation Template with Yuppies Illustrations
label: Pastel Play
measuredFrom: 20 exported frames at 1920×1080, sampled per pixel and drawn at 1280×720 (every source size × 2/3)

fonts.source: Poppins, the Figma file's own face (SemiBold titles, Light body); Jost Light for the Percentage & Tag label, as in the source

motif: flat colour panels and full-bleed fields, white circles and hexagon outlines as crops, soft tinted blobs under white line-art shapes, orange scallop arcs, rust and violet leaf shapes

layouts.statement: Text & Illustration (long text) / Important Text (short text)
layouts.text: Title & Text (salmon panel left) / Title & Text-1 (lime panel right), alternating
layouts.team: Title & Subtitles-1 (hexagon crop, purple connector lines)
layouts.closing: Thank You! / Questions? (when the title ends in a question mark)
layouts.chart: frame: lime page (Cover / Three points field), title at the 120px inset, chart below
